units.Cada KPI contaba una parte de la histori: Each KPI told part of the story.
units.Al revisar el rendimiento de marketing,: When marketing performance was reviewed, the main KPIs were analysed separately. That made it hard to understand how results, investment and efficiency related to each other.
units.Mi objetivo fue reunirlos en un mismo an: My aim was to bring them into a single analysis, so 2025 could be compared with 2024 on the same basis.
units.¿La inversión estaba funcionando mejor q: Was the investment working better than the year before?
units.Quería responder una pregunta sencilla:: I wanted to answer a simple question: were we getting better results from the investment made in 2025?
units.Para responderla, comparé los principale: To answer it, I compared the main indicators with 2024 and put the KPIs in the same frame of reference: Impressions, Reach, Engagement, Clicks, CTR, Spend, Conversions, CPC and Conversions €. Filtered by platform, post type, campaign and month.
units.No buscaba únicamente ver si una cifra h: I wasn’t only looking at whether a figure had gone up or down, but trying to understand what lay behind that change.
units.Comparar KPIs es más útil cuando todos h: Comparing KPIs is more useful when they all speak the same language.
units.Uno de los primeros pasos fue definir un: One of the first steps was to define a common frame for the indicators. I reviewed the metrics, their definitions and how they were calculated, to make sure the comparison between years was consistent.
units.Así podía analizar diferentes KPIs sin p: That way I could analyse different KPIs without losing sight of what each one was measuring.
units.Cada KPI se muestra junto al mismo dato: Each KPI is shown next to the same figure from last year. That way I can see straight away whether something improved or got worse, without looking up the comparison figure separately.
units.Un pequeño gráfico de tendencia dentro d: A small trend chart inside each card. It shows whether a KPI had been rising or falling for a while, without changing page to check.
units.Un filtro para separar los posts con inv: A filter to separate posts with paid promotion from those without. Mixing them can hide a good organic result behind a paid campaign, or the other way round.
units.Organicé los datos en un esquema en estr: I organised the data in a star schema.
units.Para poder analizar los resultados desde: To analyse the results from different perspectives, I structured the data in a dimensional model: a fact table (fact_table) and seven dimensions: Calendar, Platform, Content, Campaign, Post type, Target audience and Boosted. That makes it possible to cut the information by platform, content type, campaign and the other variables in the analysis.
units.Esta estructura también me permitió mant: This structure also let me keep the Power BI calculations tidier and made the later analysis easier.
units.No construí el modelo porque «un esquema: I didn’t build the model because «a star schema is good practice». I built it because I needed to analyse the KPIs from different perspectives without duplicating logic or losing consistency.
units.Nueve KPIs para leer el rendimiento desd: Nine KPIs to read performance from the same perspective.
units.Con el modelo preparado, reuní los princ: With the model ready, I brought the main indicators together in a single dashboard. The idea was that someone could move from the overview to the detail without switching criteria between metrics. The dashboard compares results with the previous period and makes it quick to spot where the main changes happen.
units.Power BI · DAX · Esquema en estrella · S: Power BI · DAX · Star schema · Sparklines
units.A primera vista, los resultados parecían: At first sight, the results looked worse. Compare two figures and the story changes.
units.Si miro únicamente las impresiones, el r: If I look only at impressions, the result seems negative:
units.La lectura cambia: la inversión cayó más: The reading changes: investment fell more than impressions. That’s why looking at one metric in isolation could lead to an incomplete conclusion.
units.Este fue uno de los puntos que más me in: This was one of the points of the analysis that interested me most: a figure can look negative until we put it in context.
units.El volumen bajó, pero eso no significa a: Volume dropped, but that doesn’t automatically mean efficiency got worse.
units.Para evitar interpretar los resultados m: To avoid interpreting the results through a single metric, I separated two concepts:
units.Mide cuánto resultado se consiguió. Es ú: Measures how much result was achieved. It’s useful to know whether activity rose or fell, but on its own it doesn’t explain how much it cost to achieve.
units.Relaciona el resultado obtenido con la i: Relates the result achieved to the investment made. It shows whether we’re using resources differently from the previous period.
units.Por eso, en este análisis no me quedé ún: That’s why, in this analysis, I didn’t stop at «results have gone down». The next question was: how much did we invest to get them?
units.Para construir este análisis trabajé pri: To build this analysis I worked mainly with:
units.Para modelar los datos, crear las medida: To model the data, create the measures and build the full dashboard.
units.Para escribir las medidas que comparan c: To write the measures that compare each indicator with the previous year.
units.Para poder cambiar el periodo analizado: To change the period analysed without breaking the comparison between years.
units.Para organizar los datos con una tabla c: To organise the data around a central table and seven dimensions, and cut it from different angles.
units.Para ver la tendencia de cada KPI de un: To see each KPI’s trend at a glance, without leaving the card.
units.Para que cada métrica se lea siempre jun: So every metric is always read next to its value from the previous year.
units.Una tabla desconectada me permitió simpl: A disconnected table let me simplify how the KPIs read.
units.Una de las partes que más me interesó de: One of the parts of the build that interested me most was using a disconnected table in Power BI to control which KPI was shown in certain visuals. That let me keep the same visual structure and switch the indicator without creating a different chart for each metric.
units.Es un detalle técnico relativamente pequ: It’s a relatively small technical detail, but it helped me keep the dashboard cleaner and, above all, avoid repeating visuals unnecessarily. I also learnt that nine KPIs on a single page only work if the design has a clear hierarchy. Without it, the density of information paralyses the user instead of guiding them.
units.De «los resultados cayeron» a entender q: From «results fell» to understanding what was really going on.
units.Este proyecto me sirvió para comprobar a: This project let me test something I try to apply every time I work with data: an isolated metric rarely tells the whole story.
units.Al poner los indicadores en contexto pud: By putting the indicators in context I could tell a drop in volume apart from a change in efficiency, and better understand what might be behind the results.
units.Para mí, esa es una de las partes más in: For me, that’s one of the most interesting parts of a data analyst’s work: moving from looking at numbers to finding the question behind them.
